shared_elements: shallow relief carving of figural motifs
bird/wing imagery (bird-headed figures vs. feathered wings)
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief anthropomorphic-with-bird/wing imagery and circular disc motifs, which is about as generic as such a correspondence can get. A is a tall, vertically stacked composition of highly schematic curvilinear bird-headed forms, rings and a girdle-like band, whereas B is a horizontally spreading, densely detailed single winged figure in profile with feather-by-feather rendering, beaded fringes and a rosette bracelet — the depictive conventions and the specific combinations share nothing distinctive.
